entries.subtitle: An international youth organization uniting FIRST teams across borders
entries.summary: Global FIRST Action Assembly — engineering beyond borders. Founded by MAVERICKS FTC #24034.

sections.overview:
Not a one-day summit — a long-term organization:
• Committee meetings — regular work in three committees
• International assemblies — FIRST teams from around the world
• Collaborative projects — solutions to real-world challenges
• Lasting impact — an ongoing international community
sections.approach:
Three committees:
• STEM Equality — connect schools, share knowledge, make STEM accessible to more people.
• Inclusive Engineering — engineering for every mind and body.
• Sustainable Innovation — rethink, redesign, rebuild.

Meet — connect teams worldwide. Build — co-create real solutions. Act — deliver measurable impact.
